result.title: Coupled or Independent? Fault Coupling in Agentic Medical Vision Systems
result.summary: Vision-language agents equipped with tools expose intermediate outputs for inspection and comparison with the model's reasoning, which may offer safety benefits over single-shot models. This paper tests that potential benefit when the sensor reading itself is untrusted, so that the tool and reasoning channels share a common visual fault. We consider a dermatology agent based on segmentation, contrastive retrieval, and an iterative vision-language reasoner and define a coupling taxonomy that distinguishes single-channel errors from joint errors that agree or disagree. On PAD-UFES-20, we show that typographic injection produces detectable directional retrieval capture, whereas physical corruption does not. Crop-first retrieval preserves the payload at a readable scale and produces 55% joint wrong agreement across all cases (71% of faulty cases); full-image retrieval produces 35% (43%). Under a binary decision, if both channels are wrong, their predictions must agree, so hard-label channel comparison cannot detect joint failures, limiting disagreement recall to 0.29 (crop-first) versus 0.57 (full-image). The direction of the order effect is reproduced on the independent HIBA test set.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究医学视觉语言 agent 在传感器读数本身不可信、工具与推理通道共享同一视觉故障时，中间输出可核查性是否仍成立；作者搭建分割—检索—迭代推理的皮肤科 agent，提出单通道错误与联合错误（一致/不一致）的耦合分类，并在 PAD-UFES-20 上比较排版注入与物理损坏下的检索捕获与联合错误比例。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接检验「通道间分歧可作为视觉证据筛选与错误检测信号」这一隐含假设：若两通道同错则硬标签比较必然一致，分歧召回受限，对 latent 通道比较、视觉旁路监控与证据因果作用的评估可能构成反例与可复用指标。
